description: Arithmetic on published prices: unit price × quantity, using exact unit conversions (acre↔hectare, sq ft↔m², mile↔km), preferring benchmarks whose region matches the country, converting currency at a dated ECB rate. Returns the range plus the basis rows (each with source_url, as_of, region match) and caveats. Returns estimate=null with a reason when no sourced benchmark fits; never invents a number. Example: {"use_case":"crop-spraying-drone","quantity":500,"unit":"hectare","country":"BR","currency":"USD"}.

country.description: Buyer country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 ("AE") or English name ("United Arab Emirates").

currency.description: Express the result in this ISO 4217 currency

quantity.description: How many units (hectares, shows, months, inspections…). Omit for a per-unit price.

unit.description: Unit of quantity, e.g. "hectare", "acre", "show", "month", "sq ft". Omit to use the most common benchmark unit.

name: estimate_cost

estimate.description: null = no sourced benchmark fits; never guessed

title: Estimate a job cost from sourced benchmarks
